title: Does Meta's brain-response model (TRIBE v2) actually recover retinotopy/tonotopy/motion maps? [D]
summary: TRIBE v2 predicts fMRI from video/audio/text. Its own paper never tested whether it reproduces classic topographic maps (retinotopy, tonotopy, motion selectivity) — and its methods section admits video features get spatially averaged before prediction, which should wreck position
reason: Reddit [D] discussion post questioning TRIBE v2's topographic maps; it links only to the Reddit thread, not an original paper or official source, so rule 2-1 (research artifact) is unmet and no other rule covers commentary.
